description: This file is a PHP source file defining the 'Cheque' payment controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages the display and confirmation processes for the cheque payment method, handling order status updates and redirecting upon successful transaction completion.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: A controller class for handling Cheque payment method, extending the core Controller class, providing methods for displaying payment info and confirming the order.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the cheque payment information page, displaying payable details and address.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation process for the cheque payment, updating order status, and returning JSON response with success or error messages.
